::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 29th [1870]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Katherine Wykes-Sneyd[^1]
:::

[To [Mary Penelope Fursdon](people/person_539.qmd)]

[Gosling](organizations/other_104.qmd) questions for February

Write the history of Henry VIII's expedition to France.

What parallel stories does folklore in different countries present to the adventures of Ulysses in the Odyssey?

Mother Goose

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper, with black-edged blue envelope addressed to Miss Mary Fursdon/ Fursdon/ Tiverton postmarked Winchester 29 Jan and Tiverton 30 Jan 1870.
